senses.gloss:
तीक्ष्ण- + अंशु तीक्ष्ण- + अंशु,
 I. adj. having hot beams.
 II. m. 1. the sun. 2. fire.

† तिक् तिक्, i. 1, Ātm. To go. ii. 5, Par.
 1. To go.
 2. To assail.
 3. To seek to injure.
 4. To challenge.
† तीक् तीक्, i. 1, Ātm. To go, see तिक्.

तिक्तक तिक्त + क (vb. तिज्),
 I. adj. Bitter, Suśr. 1, 215, 21.
 II. m. or n. An object of bitter taste, Suśr. 2, 136, 2.
 III. m. The name of several plants; Trichosanthes dioica Roxb., etc.
 --Comp.

तीक्ष्ण तीक्ष्ण, i. e. तिज् + स्न,
 I. adj., f. णा,
 1. Sharp, Rām. 1, 44, 22.
 2. Hot, Ṛt. 1, 18; flashing, Rām. 5, 29, 14.
 3. Energetic, Chr. 49, 14.
 4. Of a pungent taste, Bhag. 17, 9.
 5. Harsh, Man. 7, 140.
 6. Subtle, Śiś. 2, 109.
 II. n. Harsh speech, Rām. 2, 35, 23.
 --Comp.
तीक्ष्णता तीक्ष्ण + ता, f. Sharpness, Rām. 3, 19, 7.
तीक्ष्ण- + दंष्ट्र तीक्ष्ण- + दंष्ट्र, adj. having sharp teeth, Hiḍ. 2, 7.
तीक्ष्ण-धार तीक्ष्ण-धार, 1. adj. having a sharp edge, MBh. 1, 786. 2. m. a sword, MBh. 12, 6203.
तीक्ष्ण- + वृषण तीक्ष्ण- + वृषण, m. a proper name, Pañc. 135, 20.
तिक्त- + शाक तिक्त- + शाक, m. 1. a bitter vegetable, Rājat. 5, 49(?). 2. the name of several plants.
